scope: Existing manual_valves layout; no hardware mapping or output activation
notice: Logical requests only. EX260 channel/coil mapping and physical verification pending.

valves.createByCopyOf: existing momentary command and status inside same card
valves.stateText: let h=HMIRuntime.Tags("SMC_Logical_HmiLinkOK");let hv=h.Read();let hq=h.LastError===0&&(Number(h.QualityCode)&192)>=128;let s=HMIRuntime.Tags("SMC_Y1_State");let sv=s.Read();let sq=s.LastError===0&&(Number(s.QualityCode)&192)>=128;if(!hq||!Boolean(hv)||!sq)return "NO DATA";switch(Number(sv)){case 0:return "IDLE";case 1:return "INTERLOCKED";case 2:return "RELEASE";case 3:return "ACCEPTED";case 4:return "MULTIPLE";default:return "INVALID STATE";}
valves.statusMeaning: ACCEPTED = software request accepted; not coil or valve-position feedback
